scope: Checked the standard-security-handler algorithm steps, parameter rules and related serialization locators against the locally supplied ISO 32000-2:2020 sponsored EC3 text, clauses 7.6, 7.3, 7.5.5 and Table D.3. This verifies the PDF-level composition of primitives, not their external standards. Full SASLprep, host-codepage conversion, R5 extension provenance, crypt-filter text conflicts and document integration remain explicitly qualified below; no complete PDF conformance claim is made.

requirements.gaps: RFC 1321 and FIPS 180-4 are unavailable locally; the cited sections and known-answer values have not been rechecked against those texts.
requirements.known_answer_coverage: Seven RFC-1321-attributed MD5 messages; SHA-256/384/512 empty, abc, multi-block and million-a values; streaming splits; Python hashlib padding-boundary comparisons for lengths 0 through 261.

requirements.gaps: FIPS 197, SP 800-38A and RFC 6229 are unavailable locally; external primitive locators and attributed vectors remain pending primary-source verification.
requirements.known_answer_coverage: AES-128/256 Appendix-C-attributed block encryption/decryption; four-block CBC-128/256 SP-800-38A-attributed vectors; seven RFC-6229-attributed RC4 key sizes and offsets 0,16,256 for the 40-bit key; invalid padding and streaming checks. Python AES/RC4 self-checks use the same fixed attributed values.

requirements.gaps: Document-layer dictionary and crypt-filter discrepancies are listed under integration_findings; Table 25 Length wording is internally inconsistent.

clauses: Adobe Supplement to ISO 32000-1, extension level 3
requirements.gaps: Table 21 prohibits R=5 in conforming PDF 2.0. Compatibility support remains separate; the Adobe extension text is unavailable locally.
requirements.permissions_policy: Password-authenticated keys report Validated or Inconsistent(PermissionsCheck); the document caller owns strict/reported-repair policy. Structural errors remain Syntax.

requirements.gaps: Only printable ASCII preprocessing is supported; other input returns security.saslprep before truncation. RFC 4013/3454 are not locally verified. Document-layer findings remain open.
requirements.permissions_policy: Password-authenticated keys report Validated or Inconsistent(PermissionsCheck); the document caller owns strict/reported-repair policy. Structural errors remain Syntax.

tests: crypto/dictionary-* vector inputs and explicit API expectations
requirements.gaps: Integration findings below are not fixes to the document crate and are not counted as conformance successes.

primary_text.edition: ISO 32000-2:2020, sponsored edition with Errata Collection 3
primary_text.method: Read the accompanying local extraction; locators and original paraphrases only. No licensed text is redistributed.

integration_findings.observed: Strict open succeeds without diagnostics and the stream decrypts.

integration_findings.discrepancy: Treats security-handler delegation as unprocessed Identity data.
integration_findings.expected: unsupported or rejected for the Standard handler, not silent Identity
integration_findings.observed: Strict open succeeds without diagnostics and the plaintext input passes through unchanged.

integration_findings.discrepancy: Skips every Type Metadata stream instead of only document-level XMP.
integration_findings.observed: Strict open succeeds without diagnostics, but stream_data(7 0) differs from the independent plaintext.

integration_findings.discrepancy: Applies an inapplicable EncryptMetadata false flag to V=1 stream selection.
integration_findings.observed: Strict open succeeds without diagnostics, but stream_data(6 0) differs from the independent plaintext.

integration_findings.discrepancy: Drops the authenticated key's Inconsistent status without a strict rejection or diagnostic.
integration_findings.expected: strict rejection or explicit reported recovery
integration_findings.observed: Strict and Repair open both succeed with zero diagnostics although the crypto key reports a permissions mismatch.

integration_findings.discrepancy: Accepts missing or malformed required IDs for V=5 files.
integration_findings.observed: All three V=5 inputs (absent ID, one element, one-byte identifiers) open strictly without diagnostics and decrypt their streams.

integration_findings.discrepancy: The CLI text flag is converted directly to UTF-8 bytes, and document authentication forwards them unchanged. Legacy authentication requires PDFDocEncoding; raw byte API callers can already supply it.
integration_findings.expected: The text password U+20AC is converted to its PDFDocEncoding byte before authenticating R3; prepared byte API succeeds.
integration_findings.observed: Prepared PDFDocEncoding bytes open through Document successfully; UTF-8 bytes fail with Password. The release CLI text password U+20AC also reports Password.

recovery_review.note: Literal EOL preservation, zero hash-padding removal and unsigned-P reinterpretation are reported repairs rather than normative parsing rules. No additional discrepancy was identified in that file; they are not marked verified standard behaviour.

corrected_oracles.crypto/r4-key7: The former successful-authentication expectation allowed an invalid 56-bit V=4 file key. Table 20 requires 128 bits, so this is now a syntax-rejection vector. R3 five- and seven-byte vectors continue to check the variable-length derivation math.
